messages:
nina: CloudForge partner asked for a hands-on "deploy & demo" showing marketplace onboarding + terraform starter kit. Requirements: airgapped option, simple KMS example, and a smoke inference. They prefer Wed 11am PT.

tom: sounds doable. propose a 45m lab: 10m creds & architecture, 20m run terraform + deploy, 10m smoke tests, 5m Q&A. will draft checklist.

reza: heads-up the terraform starter uses `provider.region` vs `cloud_region` mismatch for some partner clouds. i'll add compatibility aliases and a presets file for CloudForge regions.

alina: i'll author `presets/cloudforge.tfvars` with image tags and nat/egress notes. also include KMS env example: `REDWOOD_KMS_URI` and sample HSM config.

ci-bot: CI: terraform/starter-kit #881 succeeded  plan shows 2 new resources. (https://ci.redwood.dev/881)

jon: legal ask: can partner redistribute the sample templates under their branding? repo LICENSE is MIT; yes but add NOTICE and keep our copyright line.

ethan: for airgapped installs, include an import step: `registry pull redwood/llm-runtime:2026-04 && docker save | scp` and a note about kernel packages (glibc mismatch causes segfaults).

nina: good call. tom can you add the docker pull snippet and an explicit kernel version recommendation? also add a short troubleshooting FAQ for segfaults and connection timeouts.

tom: done. checklist live at `.docs/marketplace-lab-quickstart.md`. expected smoke outputs: health endpoint returns JSON `{"status":"ok"}`, model ready within 45s on 20GB GPU, sample inference <400ms for tiny prompts.

reza: i added `--allow-unsigned` flag in examples for partner dev runs; default remains strict signature check. mention caveat in README.

alina: pushed presets and a small readme section about private NAT egress and firewall ports (443 outbound for license checks, 123 for NTP).

jon: updated LICENSE headers in examples and added a short paragraph about rebranding in `LEGAL.md`.

ethan: i'll run the smoke tests during the demo. suggest the curl for inference:

```
curl -s -X POST https://$HOST/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}],"max_tokens":8}'
```

rezA: small note: if partner uses older kernels, set `KV_PREFETCH=false` and increase `CACHE_SIZE` in runtime env. included troubleshooting blurb.

nina: thanks all. can we do a dry run Monday 9am PT? owners: tom (runbook), reza (modules), alina (presets), ethan (smoke tests). i'll send calendar invite and share the repo link in the partner thread. :rocket:
